correctness.rationale: From the exact last-reset decomposition P(A_t=j)=u_(t-j)(j+1)^(-alpha), the generating function is C(w,z)=S_alpha(zw)/[(1-w)S_alpha(w)]. Positive interarrival probabilities eliminate extraneous poles on the unit circle. Polylog singularity at w=1 yields coefficient (sin pi alpha/pi) S_alpha(z)t^(alpha-1); singularity at w=z^-1 yields z^t H_alpha(z^-1)t^(-alpha). Multiple-singularity transfer gives the three stated alpha regimes, including their sum at alpha=1/2. For z=-1, S(-1)=eta(alpha), H(-1)=1/(2eta(alpha)); eta in (0,1) and 2eta(1/2)^2<pi enforce strict parity signs. Spectral projections give trace-norm dephasing only between distinct eigenvalues. Independently computed two exact finite-age recursions for alpha .25,.5,.75 agreeing for all tested n<=150; this does not prove asymptotics. Critical complex-phase cancellations on subsequences excluded from any universal nonzero-amplitude assertion.
